headline: Britain + Nordic allies announce Northern Maritime Alliance to hunt Russian submarines

sources: Financial Times interview with Air Chief Marshal Sir Richard Knighton, Chief of the Defence Staff (Nov 8, 2026); carries by Brit Brief, United24 Media, Izvestia, The British Eye, LADbible
fault_line: Is Britain genuinely behind its allies on Russia -- or is the top general talking up the threat to win a bigger defence budget?

sections.what_happened: [VERIFIED FACT -- the quotes] UK Chief of the Defence Staff Air Chief Marshal Sir Richard Knighton told the FT: 'This is the most dangerous period I've known in my adult life'; the threat, 'principally from Russia, but more broadly globally', is rising; Britain needs to 'catch up with our European allies', who are more alert to the Kremlin's growing appetite for risk. He said 'hybrid activity' no longer captures the scale: 'We're talking about targeted assassinations, we're talking about sabotage, we're talking about cyber attacks. These are very real, real things [by] the Russian state we have proof of in Europe and to some extent in the UK.' He also told the BBC on Sunday he was responding to the government's call for households to stockpile water and food. [VERIFIED FACT -- the alliance] Britain and the Nordic countries will create a Northern Maritime Alliance to deter Russian submarines in the North Atlantic, Arctic and Baltic Seas, developed through the UK-led Joint Expeditionary Force (JEF); the signing ceremony is scheduled for Tuesday Nov 10 aboard HMS Prince of Wales. [ATTRIBUTED REPORT -- unverified] European security officials are investigating whether a series of bomb threats against European airlines and news organisations originated in Russia; officials told the FT there is 'still a long way to go before attribution can be made'.

sections.what_disputed: No Russian response in-window; the bomb-threat origin is explicitly unproven per the FT's own reporting; the 'falling behind allies' framing is Knighton's assessment, not a measured readiness figure.
sections.why_matters: Warning + reveal: Britain's own military chief says this is the most dangerous period of his adult life -- and a new three-seas submarine-hunting alliance signs on Tuesday. Proven lane (NATO/Russia war warnings).
